author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a rider leaning forward over two wheels, arm to the handlebar, bent leg to the pedal, fork from the bar to the front wheel. Head (r2, the approved 4x4 circle, rendering as a solid dot as in common cyclist glyphs) is centred on the forward lean at N + (6,-8), exactly 10 - 2 = 8 from the neck (24,16) on centerlines, and the neck is the nearest body point. HRECT_L candidates were rejected: small r4 wheels, then with r5 wheels the handlebar sat 6 above the wheel and the thigh started 7.2 from the arm (internal-spacing review). The rejected drawing had a ring-and-dot head and a stubby frame.
omissions: The head is a small solid circle rather than an open ring (a larger ring needs a 13- or 15-unit neck offset that leaves no room for the torso above the wheels); the rear wheel is not joined by a frame, as in the reference.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'bike' (two circles with straight frame strokes); human proportions from icon_set/references/human_ref/full_body_ref.png.
